before.summary: Physical attacks deal +50% damage to flying enemies.
fullRules: Physical attacks deal +50% damage to flying enemies.

after.summary: Physical attacks deal +50% damage to flying enemies. Flying enemies within 3 tiles are slowed by 25%.
fullRules: Physical attacks deal +50% damage to flying enemies. Flying enemies within 3 tiles are slowed by 25%.
The slow applies only while inside an active aura; no hit is required and no slow lingers after leaving.
Ground enemies are unaffected. Existing Slow immunity applies; only the strongest applicable movement slow or Slow Aura applies.

implementationRules: Assert the exact FR-004 baseline and apply each specified recipe/ability replacement once before faction conversion.

Do not change any primary attack field, full-cycle DPS, damage type, target mode, weapon cycle, continuous weapon, immunity aura, recipe outside Boar Lancer, approved artwork, review identity, casting, model binary or player score.

Sky Hunt slowing is a continuous enemy-targeted air-only aura. No attack or hit is required; Physical immunity and evasion do not stop its geometric coverage. Apply it only inside the radius of an active source, without a three-second linger. Existing Slow immunity and control/boss rules still apply; combine by strongest applicable movement slow, including ordinary Slow and Slow Aura, never addition.

Sky Hunt remains one ability with a Physical anti-air damage bonus and an independent Slow aura; it does not add a second Slow-family assignment. The damage bonus retains its existing Physical attack contract.
Use existing canonical Freeze I and Stun I contracts, including current boss recovery and control-immunity gates. Golem keeps its existing Freeze I.

Heavy Sniper receives the exact canonical Execution I contract already used by Master Sniper; all five machine Ricochet I/II assignments reuse the current canonical definitions and proc rules without changing other owners.
Multishot uses the existing distinct-target contract and magazine/reload/spin-up mechanics; displayed single-target primary DPS is not multiplied by the target count.
Splash radius is a shared global change; damage percentages, damage type, eligibility, original-victim exclusion and proc rules remain exact.
Remove Stone Gaze from current family/assignment output and redirect its old family/level links to Stun I. Preserve original evidence.
Update current roster, ability catalogue, coverage exports, exact used-by lists, role/inheritance copy and all legacy aliases together.
Keep one local gallery without version switches, alternative datasets, archives or hosting. Preview status must remain pending until actual approval/implementation.
acceptanceTests: Verify 258 profiles and 114 recipes; exactly one Boar Lancer ingredient changes.
Verify 559 ability occurrences, 41 families, 159 distinct family-level numbers and 167 preserved parameter variants.
Verify Sky Hunt I/II/III continuously slow flying enemies 25/50/75% inside 3/4/5 tiles, with no hit requirement or lingering duration, strongest-only and respecting existing Slow immunity.
Verify all five machine champions have exactly one classified Multishot assignment with 2/3/5/5/10 distinct targets.
Verify Siege Cannon Freeze I; Golem Stun I plus retained Freeze I and no Stone Gaze; Mortar Dwarf no Ricochet.

Verify Heavy Sniper has exactly the canonical Execution I contract already used by Master Sniper, and the five machine Ricochet assignments are I/I/II/II/II without duplicates or unrelated level changes.
Verify all21selected Visibility assignments are removed and every unrelated Visibility owner remains exact.
Verify shared Splash radii 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 and every unchangedparameter/owner.
Verify existing and new legacy links resolve and no removed or phantom assignment remains.
Verify all primary fields/DPS, other abilities and otherrecipesexact; all protected source/media/review identities unchanged.

After implementation only, run actual-engine on-hit/immunity/control/proc regression tests and paired Diamond Spiral campaigns without TOP; do not reuse current FR-004 results as validation of FR-005.
